findings.summary: safeExcerpt() in openaiResponses.ts does not strip Unicode bidi reordering characters before the ch >= ' ' filter, unlike every other sanitiser in the codebase; provider-controlled error text reaching governance records or owner-visible output can carry bidi overrides.

nextClaudeInstruction from the gatekeeper is carried into the worker prompt with only truncation and character-level filtering; no independent semantic validation is applied, but the risk is acknowledged, documented, and bounded by the 2000-character hard limit.
rehearsalOnly flag is refused on any non-rehearsal transport kind; the inverse (rehearsal transport without the flag) is also refused — both directions structurally enforced.
decidedBy field now derives from config.decidedBy (transport configuration), independent of expectedDecider (committed delegation record); circular self-validation closed.
Cross-project thread leakage prevented by set-level isolation checks in gatekeeperThread.ts with consistent normalisation on both sides of the comparison.
Stale decision replay prevented by four independent bindings (projectId, phaseId, subjectCommit, requestDigest) plus consumedAt field and alreadyConsumedDecisionIds set from the ledger.
Self-approval blocked by isImplementerName() checks on decidedBy in decisions and grantedBy in degraded grants; isModelName() also refuses gatekeeper/GPT/ChatGPT/OpenAI identities.
Cost runaway TOCTOU race closed by serialised admitSpend admission lock: ledger read, budget evaluation, and provisional entry write all occur inside one exclusive file-lock acquisition.
Duplicate gatekeeper calls after restart prevented by deterministic request ID derivation (SHA-256 over projectId, phaseId, subjectCommit, ask, evidenceDigest) plus ledger deduplication.
Degraded-mode escalation refused: any grantedScope entry in ownerOnlyActions causes rejection; empty scope refused; grant must be read from committed tree.

Reconciliation bypass prevented: a work item is only cleared when a ReconciliationRecord has decisionAccepted === true, ask === RECONCILIATION_ASK, and a non-null decisionId; ALREADY_ASKED keyed on durable installation ledger.
Override replay prevented by unavailabilityId binding in checkDegradedModeGrant plus alreadyConsumedGrantIds set and consumedAt field.
Direct gatekeeper-to-Claude bypass prevented: STOP_ROUTES excludes APPROVED_TO_PROCEED from all stops that require review existence; owner-gated verdicts absent from every stop's applicableVerdicts.
Model escalation abuse prevented: selectTier() defaults to 'strong' for any unrecognised ask; only explicitly listed routine asks receive the routine tier.
Credential leakage prevented structurally: CredentialResolver.resolve() returns a use(fn) callback; secret never assigned outside the callback; brokered transport never invokes the resolver.
Evidence poisoning prevented: projectId, phaseId, subjectCommit and requestDigest are stamped from runtime-controlled request fields, never from model reply.
Subject drift via empty commit string closed: authoriseCorrection() explicitly refuses correction where either subjectCommit is empty on either side of the binding check.
Missing or NaN budget policy fields now cause BUDGET_STOPPED rather than acting as no limit; policyProblems() validates both hardStopAtMicroUsd and warnAtMicroUsd.
Budget raise authority now requires both decision ID match and scope === gatekeeper-budget-raise; a plan-approval or other owner decision cannot satisfy the check.
Delegation identity check now runs full checkClosureDelegationRecord validation with requiredScope; programmeId must also match between working-tree and committed config.
Broker execute-then-verify race closed: verified bytes are passed as stdin to node -e rather than re-read from disk at execution time.
Broker environment allowlist prevents NODE_OPTIONS, NODE_PATH and GIT_* inheritance; env constructed from scratch using only PASSED_ENV.
Bridge provenance denylist is applied case-insensitively over attacker-chosen key names; prevents DecidedBy or DECIDEDBY bypassing a case-exact check.
Bridge denylist applied over both top-level request fields and request.arguments keys, closing the path where a provenance field could be placed inside the arguments object.
Bridge argument values restricted to IDENTIFIER regex /^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$/; free-text prose refused at the bridge boundary, closing natural-language-to-instruction channel.
pathsNamedIn() extension whitelist is invisible to callers; a correction for an unlisted extension is refused with no indication why. Behaviour is documented and intentional.
appendLedger() comment says 'appends' but implementation rewrites the full file atomically via temp-file-rename; comment is slightly misleading about mechanism but implementation is correct.
GKDEC- prefix convention is duplicated between gatekeeperConfig.ts and openaiResponses.ts without a shared constant; silent breakage if either changes independently.

Default answered callback in admitGatekeeperSpend returns 'unknown', which conservatively refuses retries; callers unaware of the default will get permanent refusals. Behaviour is intentional and documented.
